text: Completed latent typed-core slice: explicit BOLDZip spatial basis ADTs and index types, DctSpec/RidgePenalty, coefficient/covariance coordinate ADTs, native-only/template-capable transport decoders, structured LatentError payloads, and LatentArchiveResponse variants.
